findings.description: Keyboard focus is not visible on interactive controls: a focused Add to cart button (and the other links/buttons) renders with no focus ring; computed outline-style and box-shadow are none, so Tab navigation shows no visual indication of focus (WCAG 2.4.7).
repro: Sign in as customer at 1280px wide.
Click the page background, then press Tab until focus reaches the Add to cart button of Sauce Labs Bike Light.
Observe the focused button looks identical to its unfocused state; computed outline-style is none.

findings.description: At 360px wide the product sort select collapses to about 40px, so only the funnel icon shows; the current sort option text (e.g. Name (A to Z)) and the dropdown caret are not visible, so a phone user cannot tell which sort is applied.
repro: Set viewport to 360x740 (mobile), sign in as customer.
Look at the right side of the products header row next to the Products label.
Observe the select is a small box with only a funnel icon; its width is about 40px versus about 225px on desktop.

findings.description: The cart link's accessible name reads 'Cart, 1 items' when exactly one item is in the cart; it should be 'Cart, 1 item'.
repro: Add one product to the cart.
Inspect the cart link's aria-label: it reads 'Cart, 1 items'.

notes: Tested 1280px and 360px flows: login, sort, add/remove, cart, checkout totals (subtotal, 8% tax, total verified), finish. Not covered: 1920px, hamburger menu links, Reset App State, logout, full console audit. Checkout with an empty cart completes with an order confirmation; not filed, as it may be standard shop behaviour.
